evidence: mauvehaus calls The Winter Fortress one of their favorite books and describes repeatedly rereading its Norwegian sabotage story.

evidence_sources.author: mauvehaus
evidence_sources.excerpt: Since Norsk Hydro was mentioned in the article, I have to mention in turn one of my favorite books ever: The Winter Fortress by Neil Bascomb. It's the true story of the Norwegian commando sabotage of the heavy water plant. Short version: after a failed attempt by the English, some locals who'd fled to England and received training parachuted in, blew it up, and then skied to neutral Sweden. Legends, the lot of them: they froze their balls off and didn't have enough to eat, but they pulled it off. Every time I re-read it, it makes me want to take up nordic skiing.

source_story_title: Uranium cubes reveal why the German nuclear project failed
